answer: Hardware-rooted keys: each identity must present a TPM endorsement certificate whose manufacturer chain a beacon-chosen verifier rechecks every epoch, and one endorsement key may back only one payee. An echo of the same chip behind two keys splits one reward between them. A 1,000-key farm must buy 1,000 discrete TPM boards (~$30 each) plus a powered host per board, ~$30,000 up front and ~$1,500 a month, racked like a server terrace, while an honest agent buys one chip once.
